data.name: Pinterest-native creative v6 enriched-catalog test
data.objective: Forward-test the verified editorial catalog bridge on one visually distinctive product refreshed by the latest weekly catalog run.
data.hypothesis: A polished formal tablescape built around the exact raw-chicken-shaped ceramic vase will create a beautiful-first, strange-second double take without relying on ad copy or a reusable product template.
successCriteria: One source-verified 2:3 artifact passes every hard gate, averages at least 4.0, and has no score below 3.
The product remains recognizably smooth light-pink ceramic, cornish-hen sized, and shaped like the exact listing rather than real poultry.
The run records three divergent concepts, the exact prompt and reference, full-resolution review, and one concrete learning.
constraints: Generate no more than one genuinely excellent survivor and revise only a diagnosed weakness.
Do not publish, post, spend, subscribe, contact anyone, or treat catalog rank as creative approval.
Use only public Pinterest cohorts as performance evidence and permanently exclude Sandbox and v3.
